summary: iter335.16 — Maker-facing channel-split hint + theme-digest cron. All 9 new tests + 117/117 cumulative iter335 regression pass. Live API verified end-to-end (401 unauth, 200 with maker JWT). Frontend self-hide path confirmed (eligible_channels=0 cold-start → section absent). Frontend visible path confirmed via mocked API (Google 67% / Meta 33% rows render, microsoft ineligible row hidden, green progress bars, correct subtitle).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/promote.py /promote/channel-split: gateway eligibility is queried sequentially for each of the 3 channels via `await get_gateway(ch).is_eligible(...)`. With 3 channels this is fine, but if new ad platforms are added consider `asyncio.gather` to parallelise — currently each request makes one extra round-trip per channel.

scheduler._job_theme_suggestions_digest: marker is keyed on `global` doc with `last_sent_date` checked against UTC date. Works for one-shop/marketplace-wide digest but if you ever need per-tenant digests the marker schema will need to evolve (per-region or per-org keys).

PromoteTab.jsx self-hide gate `channelSplit.eligible_channels >= 2` correctly hides for cold-start state, but if backend evolves to return `eligible_channels: 1` (one channel newly connected) the row would still render data — but the heading 'Recommended split' implies multi-channel. Current >=2 gate is the right call; just document in component the rationale so future contributors don't relax it to >=1.
